newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CBA gives full rate cut to business.
newsitem.headline: CBA gives full rate cut to business.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Wednesday that it would pass on the full 50 basis point easing on monetary policy to its business customers.

The bank, which like the other majors has come under pressure from the government this year for not passing on all of the central bank's official cash easings, said its prime rate for corporate borrowers would be reduced to 8.45 percent on August 18. Its rate for other commercial borrowers would be reduced to 8.95 percent.
